personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (Customized for Modern Fintech)
personality_one_liner: A sleek, cinematic dark-mode finance tracker where vibrant neon accents glow softly behind frosted glass, prioritizing glanceability and emotional reward.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room to allow the dark mode UI to feel cinematic. Avoid cramped lists; use intentional padding around cards.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar and header over scrolling content.
Use glass overlay on the hero Balance Card with a tinted translucent background.
Ensure a 75%+ opacity dark tint sits under any text on glass to maintain contrast.
dont's: Do not use glass for list rows or form inputs.
Do not use glass without an underlying tint layer.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard displaying the main balance, quick actions, savings pots, and recent activity.

states.loading: Dark pulse skeleton over main cards.
states.empty: Empty state illustration showing a vault with a 'Add your first transaction' CTA.
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Retry' button in pink.

screens.layout: Header with greeting -> Large Hero Balance Card (abstract background image heavily tinted) showing Total Balance prominently -> Quick action buttons (+ Entrata [Green], - Uscita [Pink], Trasferisci [Purple]) in a row -> Horizontal scroll of Sezioni/Risparmi (glass cards with progress indicators) -> Recent Transactions list.

screens.name: Sezioni (Pots)
screens.purpose: Detailed view of all savings sections with progress bars and transfer options.
screens.layout: Grid or vertical list of savings pots. Each pot displays current amount vs target, using green/pink/purple subtle gradients on the progress rings.

screens.name: Add Transaction
screens.purpose: Bottom sheet or modal to quickly log an income or expense.

states.error: Form validation errors highlighted in Pink.

screens.layout: Large numeric input -> Segmented control (Entrata/Uscita) -> Category selector -> Section/Pot selector -> Add note -> Sticky Submit button.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Visual breakdown of spending and income by category.

states.empty: No data to show yet. Add a transaction.

screens.layout: Donut or bar charts showing expenses vs income. Utilize the Green (Income) and Pink (Expenses) colors heavily here for visual correlation.

hero_background.alt: Abstract dark background with green and pink neon strokes, providing a cinematic backdrop for the balance card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color requirements: Main UI is Black/Gray (surface and surfaceSecondary), with Purple as primary brand, Green for Income (Entrate), and Pink for Expenses (Uscite).

Apply the abstract hero_background to the main balance card using expo-image, but you MUST overlay it with a heavy dark gradient scrim (vertical, transparent to >80% surface opacity) so the white balance text remains WCAG AAA readable.
For the transaction logging flow, use @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Ensure the segmented control immediately flips the context color (e.g., active tint changes to Green for Entrata, Pink for Uscita).
Use 'Space Grotesk' for balances and prominent numbers to give a tabular, modern fintech feel, and 'Satoshi' for body/labels.
When updating the balance: Entrata adds to the total, Uscita subtracts from it. Ensure the logic binds to the correct savings section/pot.
Do NOT use generic blue or default Material indigo anywhere in the app. Stick to the provided palette.
Include subtle haptics (react-native-haptic-feedback or expo-haptics) on the number pad / transaction submit actions.
